title: Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements): Schedule of Applicability by Rate Schedule, Member Type and Account Status
content:
**Cedar Fork Electric Cooperative — Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements)**
**Schedule of applicability**

Each tier of Payment Arrangements (Deferred Payment Agreements) applies only to service accounts on the rate schedules, held by the member types, and standing in the account statuses listed against it below. The table also gives each tier's minimum connected service and whether a final-billed account may be placed on the agreement.

| Tier | Rate schedules of the service account | Member types | Account statuses in which an offer may be made | Minimum connected service | Final-billed account |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | Schedule R Residential Service; Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service | individual, joint | active; disconnect pending; disconnected for nonpayment | 6 full calendar months | not allowed |
| Extended Hardship Payment Agreement | Schedule R Residential Service; Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | individual, joint | active; disconnect pending; disconnected for nonpayment | 0 months (no minimum) | not allowed |
| Winter Protection Payment Agreement | Schedule R Residential Service; Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | individual, joint | active; disconnect pending; disconnected for nonpayment | 0 months (no minimum) | not allowed |
| Medical Certificate Payment Agreement | Schedule R Residential Service; Schedule FH Farm and Home Service | individual, joint | active; disconnect pending; disconnected for nonpayment | 0 months (no minimum) | not allowed |
| Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement | Schedule FH Farm and Home Service; Schedule IR Irrigation Service | individual, joint, business | active; disconnect pending; disconnected for nonpayment | 12 full calendar months | not allowed |
| Commercial Installment Agreement | Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service; Schedule GS-3 Three-Phase General Service; Schedule LP Large Power Service | individual, joint, business, nonprofit, government | active; disconnect pending | 12 full calendar months | not allowed |

**Notes to the schedule**

1. *Rate schedules* are the official rate schedule names of the service accounts on which the tier may be offered.
2. *Member types* are the member types recorded on the membership that may take the tier.
3. *Account statuses* are the statuses of the service account in which the tier may be offered. A service account that has been disconnected for nonpayment may be offered any tier except the Commercial Installment Agreement, whose list stops at disconnect pending.
4. *Minimum connected service* is the number of full calendar months the service account must have been connected before the tier may be offered. A figure of 0 sets no minimum.
5. *Final-billed account* — no tier allows a final-billed account to be placed on the agreement.

**Reading the schedule (hypothetical examples)**

- A hypothetical joint membership holding a Schedule RS Seasonal Residential Service account appears only on the Standard Deferred Payment Agreement row, because Schedule RS is listed for no other tier.
- A hypothetical business member with a Schedule IR Irrigation Service account appears only on the Agricultural Harvest Payment Agreement row: Schedule IR is listed only there, and business members are listed only there and on the Commercial Installment Agreement row, which does not list Schedule IR.
- A hypothetical Schedule GS-1 Single-Phase General Service account held by a nonprofit and standing disconnected for nonpayment matches the Commercial Installment Agreement by schedule and member type, but that tier's status list does not include disconnected for nonpayment.
